text:
Hotel owners evaluating an **upper-upscale conversion** typically consider a mix of **soft collections**, which preserve the property’s identity, and **hard brands**, which require greater standardization.

> **Important:** Chain-scale classifications vary by country and benchmarking provider. Some brands described as “premium” or “upscale” by their parent companies may compete directly in the upper-upscale set.

### Commonly shortlisted brands

| Hotel group | Brands commonly considered | Typical conversion fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, **Delta Hotels by Marriott**; sometimes Renaissance, Sheraton or Marriott Hotels | Autograph and Tribute suit distinctive independent hotels; Delta is one of Marriott’s principal full-service conversion flags. Marriott reports that collection and conversion-friendly brands continue to drive substantial conversion activity. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/hotel-development?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection by Hilton**, **Hilton Hotels & Resorts**; occasionally Canopy or Embassy Suites | Curio is Hilton’s principal soft-brand option at upper-upscale level. Hilton Hotels & Resorts works for larger standardized city, resort and convention properties. DoubleTree is also frequently considered, although it is generally classified as **upscale rather than upper-upscale**. ([pkhotelsandresorts.com](https://www.pkhotelsandresorts.com/~/media/Files/P/Park-Hotels/reports-and-presentations/10k-q4-2025.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG Hotels & Resorts** | **voco**, **Crowne Plaza**, and the new **Noted Collection** | voco is specifically designed as a flexible premium conversion brand. Crowne Plaza suits business and meetings-oriented hotels. Launched on **February 17, 2026**, Noted Collection targets distinctive upscale-to-upper-upscale conversions, although it is not yet as established as voco. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2026/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-unveils-new-premium-collection-brand-noted-collection?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **Hyatt Regency**, and, for resorts, Destination by Hyatt | Unbound is the clearest soft-brand option, covering upper-upscale and luxury independent properties. Hyatt Regency generally requires stronger conformity in rooms, public areas, F&B and meeting facilities. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **MGallery Hotel Collection**, **Mövenpick**, **Pullman**, **Swissôtel** | MGallery is a flexible upper-upscale collection brand. Mövenpick is frequently positioned for efficient conversions; Pullman and Swissôtel generally require a more extensive premium repositioning. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Radisson Hotel Group** | **Radisson Blu**, **Radisson Individuals**; sometimes Radisson Collection | Radisson Blu is explicitly upper-upscale and has an “easy-to-adopt” design approach. Radisson Individuals permits greater identity retention and lower capital investment, although individual properties can span more than one chain scale. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/development-opportunities/our-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham Hotels & Resorts** | **Wyndham Grand**, **Registry Collection Hotels**, and occasionally Dolce by Wyndham | Wyndham Grand is a hard upper-upscale flag. Registry is a soft upper-upscale collection for hotels retaining their identity. Dolce is an adjacent upscale/upper-upscale option, particularly for resorts and meetings-oriented assets. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/brand/dolce-hotels-resorts-by-wyndham/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **BWH Hotels / WorldHotels** | **WorldHotels Elite Collection** | A soft affiliation suitable for distinctive upper-upscale independent hotels seeking distribution without adopting a highly standardized identity. ([worldhotels.com](https://www.worldhotels.com/content/luxury-hotels/en_US/hotel-development/development-collections.html?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Minor Hotels** | **NH Collection**, sometimes nhow, Avani or Tivoli depending on positioning | Most relevant in Europe, Latin America, Asia and selected Middle Eastern markets. NH Collection is commonly evaluated for established urban hotels undergoing an upper-upscale repositioning. Minor operates these brands across a global network. ([minorhotels.com](https://www.minorhotels.com/en/development?utm_source=openai)) |

### Practical short list

For a conventional global conversion exercise, the most frequent first-round candidates would usually be:

1. **Autograph Collection**
2. **Tribute Portfolio**
3. **Curio Collection by Hilton**
4. **voco**
5. **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
6. **MGallery**
7. **Radisson Blu**
8. **Delta Hotels by Marriott**
9. **Hilton Hotels & Resorts**
10. **Crowne Plaza**
11. **Wyndham Grand**
12. **WorldHotels Elite**

### How owners normally narrow the list

- **Distinctive boutique or historic hotel:** Autograph, Curio, Unbound, MGallery, Tribute or WorldHotels Elite.
- **Standardized full-service business hotel:** Delta, Hilton, Crowne Plaza, Radisson Blu or Hyatt Regency.
- **Resort:** Autograph, Curio, Unbound, MGallery, Mövenpick, Wyndham Grand or Registry Collection.
- **Lowest identity disruption:** A soft collection is normally preferable.
- **Strongest conventional flag recognition:** Hilton, Marriott, Hyatt Regency, Crowne Plaza or Radisson Blu.
- **Lower conversion capital requirement:** Usually voco, Delta or a soft collection—subject to the property-improvement plan and existing physical condition.

The final choice is normally driven less by nominal chain scale than by **territorial availability, required renovation cost, projected brand contribution, loyalty-program penetration, fee structure, owner-control provisions and exit flexibility**.
